speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the emergency room. I see you are bringing in a newborn with respiratory distress; please tell me, what were you noticing in the baby before we arrived? How long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. Given the infant's gestational age of 33 weeks and early onset of symptoms, I am requesting a Chest_X-Ray to confirm ground-glass opacities and a Blood_Gas_Analysis to assess oxygenation and ventilation status.
